name: router-fallback
about: 路由开启、主模型 bbx/broken 回 500 时按 router.fallback.default 切到 bbx/deterministic：事件序列、发给 provider 的请求、会话记录、router/events.jsonl（决策、重试、回退事件）。另一轮主模型回 400（不可回退的错误）。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/broken
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        broken:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
    dead:
      protocol: openai
      url: http://127.0.0.1:9/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        nowhere:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
router:
  enabled: true
  fallback:
    default:
      - bbx/deterministic
